meta.name: everything-claude-code-conventions
meta.description: Development conventions and patterns for everything-claude-code. JavaScript project with conventional commits.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 统一代码规范与提交约定
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在团队中推行一致的编码和提交规范。
copy.tagline_en: Standardize code conventions and commit patterns
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to enforce consistent coding and commit conventions in your team.

howto.what: Claude 会按照 everything-claude-code 项目的开发规范来写代码、提交和测试。它会使用 Conventional Commits 格式写提交信息，遵循 camelCase 命名、混合导出等代码风格，并按照项目已有的测试模式编写测试。
howto.when: 当你在 everything-claude-code 仓库中工作，比如添加新功能、写测试、创建提交或修改代码时，这个技能会自动激活。

say.text: 帮我添加一个新技能，按照项目规范创建 SKILL.md。
say.note: Claude 会创建技能目录和文档，并遵循模板。

say.text: 为这个新功能写一个 Conventional Commits 格式的提交信息。
给这个函数写单元测试，文件命名为 *.test.js。
say.note: Claude 会创建测试文件并遵循项目测试模式。

howto.what_en: Claude will follow the development conventions of the everything-claude-code project when writing code, commits, and tests. It uses Conventional Commits format, camelCase naming, mixed exports, and existing test patterns.
howto.when_en: This skill activates when you work in the everything-claude-code repository, such as adding features, writing tests, creating commits, or modifying code.

say_en.text: Add a new skill following project conventions, create SKILL.md.
say_en.note: Claude will create skill directory and docs per template.

say_en.text: Write a Conventional Commits message for this new feature.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a message like feat: add new feature.

say_en.text: Write unit tests for this function, name the file *.test.js.
say_en.note: Claude will create test file following project patterns.
